reasoning_traces.think:
The core challenge is constructing a robust fantasy salary (s_i) that reflects both an athlete's expected performance (v_i) and their popularity (market pressure). This leads to a constrained optimization problem where the goal is to maximize total fantasy value while respecting a fixed budget (salary cap). The binary selection variable x_i indicates whether an athlete is drafted. The resulting problem is NP-hard due to combinatorial team construction but can be approximated using greedy heuristics or dynamic programming. Violation occurs when salaries are misaligned with true performance, leading to inefficient drafts.
